description: Advisory and transactional work for companies, investors and financial institutions operating in and into Bangladesh — from formation through to complex cross-border transactions.
Litigation and arbitration before the Supreme Court of Bangladesh and arbitral tribunals in Bangladesh and abroad, for banks, corporates and public-sector clients.
Sector-specific counsel for regulated industries, drawing on close working knowledge of the relevant Bangladeshi regulatory bodies and licensing regimes.
Advice to domestic and multinational employers on the full employment lifecycle, workforce structuring and labour compliance in Bangladesh.
Guidance for foreign counsel, investors and trading partners navigating market entry, cross-border trade and international regulatory exposure.
Protection and commercialisation of intangible assets, and counsel on emerging digital and financial-technology regulation.
